title: Elegant Dense Greek Semolina Galaktoboureko
description: A nostalgic Greek dish featuring semolina custard, wrapped in flaky phyllo and flavored with brandy, this galaktoboureko is a dense and decadent treat. It is also dairy-free-friendly, making it accessible to those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the semolina flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the non-dairy milk, melted vegan butter, and brandy, if using.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth.
Knead the mixture for 10 minutes until it is well combined and smooth.
Roll out the phyllo dough to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the semolina mixture evenly over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Roll the phyllo dough into a tight log, starting from the long side.
Place the log seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the top of the log with a little non-dairy milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the filling is set.
